jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

We're rethinking demand generation as a self-learning system, not just a set of campaigns. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of growth marketing and GTM engineering. You'll own the full enterprise pipeline funnel, building the data and AI-powered demand engine that makes it run and achieve its goals.

Why deepset

At deepset, we’re making sovereign AI accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced AI applications, while our enterprise platform helps teams scale across use cases, users, and environments. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on trust and ownership. You’ll work alongside strong technical talent, take on meaningful challenges, and help turn complex AI into solutions that are practical, reliable, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Full-funnel growth ownership. Own pipeline from awareness to opportunity—across inbound and outbound—connecting Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn, and other tools to power personalized journeys from prospect to customer, with clear attribution to revenue.

  • Systems builder. You build AI-assisted workflows for campaign creation, messaging, and segmentation including showcasing AI agents powering real GTM workflows on deepset's own platform

  • High-tempo experimentation & high visibility. You methodically test messaging, audiences, and channels fast across web, paid, email, social, content, and events, scaling what works into playbooks and cutting what doesn't

  • Cross-functional integrator. Tight feedback loops with Leadership, Sales, Product, DevRel, and RevOps; activating ICPs across developer and enterprise journeys, and implementing refinements and learnings to hit pipeline goals.

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years in data-driven, AI B2B , deep tech, or developer tools marketing

  • Proven track record running full-funnel demand with measurable pipeline impact

  • Comfortable with APIs, automation tools, and data workflows (Python, Claude, Haystack)

  • You think in hypotheses and have the analytics chops to iterate and prove value

  • Deep understanding of what resonates with technical audiences and business buyers

  • Your tools stack: Clay, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, intent analytics (Reo.dev, community analytics)

  • Deep familiarity with ICP mapping, value-based messaging, audience targeting, and campaign optimization

Nice to have

  • German language skills

  • Open-source community experience

  • LLM / AI product marketing background

  • Early-stage or high-growth startup experience

 

Benefits

  • Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice

  • 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave

  • Competitive salary & stock options for every team member

  • Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Monthly team socials & in-person meetups

  • Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

 

About us

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. Backed by GV and Balderton, we’re growing the world’s production AI community and customer base solving challenges too critical to get wrong.

‍Visit us to learn more: deepset Website | Haystack Website | GitHub | Linkedin | X deepset (Twitter) | X haystack (Twitter)

jobs.title: Account Executive (EU Institutions)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

You'll own the EU institutional market end to end. It is a hybrid hunter/farmer role winning new institutional logos (ECB, Parliament, Council, EU agencies) while expanding our footprint inside the European Commission, where deepset already powers the AI@EC platform. Sovereign AI has moved from policy ambition to procurement reality, and the person who builds this franchise now will own one of the most defensible books of business in European enterprise AI. This is a field role, not pipeline-from-a-desk: you'll be deepset's face in Brussels, in the rooms where procurement decisions are shaped long before a tender is published.

Why deepset

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise-ready AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Build and convert a pipeline of new institutional logos, positioning deepset in the pre-tender phase to shape requirements rather than respond to them

  • Navigate EU procurement — framework contracts, CPV-coded tenders, cascading lots — and develop partner and integrator relationships for consortium bids

  • Grow existing institutional accounts, most notably the European Commission, turning single deployments into institution-wide standards

  • Build deepset's Brussels presence through speaking slots, roundtables, executive dinners, and the institutional AI and digital-sovereignty event circuit

  • Cultivate a network across CIO/CTO offices, innovation labs, policy units, and procurement functions

  • Own account plans, stakeholder maps, and multi-year territory strategy, feeding market and policy intelligence back into the business

What you bring to the team

  • A track record of selling complex software into EU institutions specifically — you've navigated EU public procurement, framework contracts, and tenders, and closed institutional business

  • An existing network within the EU institutional ecosystem — you know how decisions get made and who makes them

  • Proven results in both motions: hunting new logos and growing installed accounts

  • Comfort with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (12–24 months) balanced against in-year expansion revenue

  • Enough technical fluency to credibly discuss AI platforms, deployment models (SaaS vs. on-premise vs. sovereign cloud), and data governance

  • Fluent English; based in Brussels or committed to relocating — this role does not work remotely

Nice to have

  • French highly valuable; German a plus

  • AI fluency: you've built your own AI tooling to drive sales efficacy — pitching, research, or message positioning

Benefits

  • Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice

  • 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave

  • Competitive salary & stock options for every team member

  • Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Monthly team socials & in-person meetups

  • Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

About us

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. Backed by GV and Balderton, we’re growing the world’s production AI community and customer base solving challenges too critical to get wrong.

‍Visit us to learn more: deepset Website | Haystack Website | GitHub | Linkedin | X deepset (Twitter) | X haystack (Twitter)

jobs.title: Account Director (Public Sector DACH)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

You'll open and build deepset's public sector business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, selling sovereign AI to federal, state and municipal administrations, both directly and through partners. It's a new-business role. There's already strong activity on the patch, and you'll have full ownership of how we win and direct access to leadership. You'll report to the Public Sector Lead and be based in Germany (ideally Berlin), with regular travel across DACH.

Why deepset

At deepset, we're making sovereign AI accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced AI applications, while our Enterprise platform helps teams scale across use cases, users, and environments. We're remote-first, flexible, and built on trust and ownership. You'll work alongside strong technical talent, take on meaningful challenges, and help turn complex AI into solutions that are practical, reliable, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Define the DACH public sector go-to-market and build a qualified pipeline from zero across federal, state and municipal accounts

  • Map buying centres end to end (CDOs, CIOs, IT service providers, procurement, DPOs, works councils, budget holders) and time pursuits to budget cycles and funding windows

  • Lead tenders end to end with pre-sales, legal, security and finance: bid / no-bid, pricing, compliance documentation and EVB-IT contract terms

  • Shape requirements early through market consultations and pilots, and run below-threshold deals quickly where they open the door to larger frameworks

  • Build a partner ecosystem with SIs, public sector IT service providers, framework holders and sovereign cloud providers, including consortium bids and framework listings

  • Close complex multi-stakeholder deals, turn first deployments into references, and bring market and compliance insight (e.g. BSI C5, IT-Grundschutz) back to Product and Leadership

What you bring to the team

  • 8+ years in enterprise software sales, with at least 5 selling to the public sector in DACH

  • A record of new-business wins in government: named contracts you sourced and closed, not only renewals you inherited

  • Hands-on experience leading tenders under EU and national procurement law (e.g. GWB, VgV, UVgO and the Austrian and Swiss equivalents), including framework agreements and EVB-IT

  • An active network across federal, state and municipal administrations, plus experience selling through partners (SIs, framework holders, resellers, cloud providers)

  • Comfort selling technical platforms to technical buyers, and credibility on data protection, security and sovereignty

  • Native or near-native German and professional English

Nice to have

  • Experience selling AI, data or open-source infrastructure

  • A scale-up background where you built a territory from scratch

  • Existing relationships with public sector IT service providers or municipal IT cooperatives

  • Familiarity with BSI C5, IT-Grundschutz and the Swiss and Austrian equivalents

  • Security clearance, or eligibility for one

Benefits

💻 Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice
🌱 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave
📈 Competitive salary & stock options for every team member
🏋️ Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva
🌱 Annual learning & development budget
🤝 Monthly team socials & in-person meetups
🐶 Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

About us

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. Backed by GV and Balderton, we’re growing the world’s production AI community and customer base solving challenges too critical to get wrong.

‍Visit us to learn more: deepset Website | Haystack Website | GitHub | Linkedin | X deepset (Twitter) | X haystack (Twitter)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

We’re hiring a Manager to lead our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team in Customer Engineering. You build a healthy, high-trust team and make sure it delivers deepset’s AI Platform into enterprise and public sector production environments, on target and on quality. You came up close to the work and still go deep when it matters.

Why deepset

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise-ready AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Own team health and culture across the four FDE profiles (Advisory, Builder, Operating, Support): a safe space where hard questions are welcome and engineers share patterns instead of working in silos.

  • Run strong 1:1s and career conversations so every FDE knows where they stand and how to grow.

  • Build the hiring and onboarding pipeline for a remote-first, async-heavy team.

  • Clear blockers fast, and escalate the ones you can’t resolve before they become delivery risks.

Run the Delivery Engine

  • Staff the right FDE profile to the right engagement and deliver against your team’s utilization targets, protecting against both burnout and idle capacity.

  • Hold the technical bar: review architecture and solution decisions across RAG pipelines, retrieval quality, deployment topology, and production operations.

  • Deliver engagements on scope and on plan, follow our delivery processes, and own resolution of customer escalations.

Collaborate Across the Organization

  • Partner with the Delivery Lead and Value Engineers on scope, feasibility, and staffing, with clear ownership at each handoff.

  • Feed field insight to Product and Engineering, and build reusable patterns that reduce custom work.

What you bring to the team

  • Experience leading customer-facing engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in enterprise software, AI, or infrastructure.

  • Strong coaching instincts: you develop engineers and build high-trust teams.

  • Technical depth to hold the bar: RAG (retrieval, embeddings, re-ranking, evaluation), cloud and self-hosted deployments, model optimization, APIs, integrations, and IAM/security fundamentals.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how scope, staffing, and execution affect utilization, revenue, and margin.

  • Clear, written and verbal communication with technical and executive audiences, and comfort with ambiguity in a remote-first setup.

Nice to have

  • Experience running services or delivery inside a SaaS or platform company navigating the move to enterprise and self-hosted deployments.

  • Experience with OKR frameworks and squad-based delivery organizations.

  • Familiarity with agent-based systems, LLM platforms, and AI-native engineering tooling-

Benefits

  • Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice

  • 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave

  • Competitive salary & stock options for every team member

  • Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Monthly team socials & in-person meetups

  • Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

About us

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. Backed by GV and Balderton, we’re growing the world’s production AI community and customer base solving challenges too critical to get wrong.

‍Visit us to learn more: deepset Website | Haystack Website | GitHub | Linkedin | X deepset (Twitter) | X haystack (Twitter)
